verdict.rationale: Bulk data export applies to a SaaS fraud and identity platform that stores customer entities and event data, but the evidence pack never documents an export feature, open-format downloads, or an offboarding path. Alloy's public REST API, OpenAPI document, entity endpoints and webhooks are developer building blocks for building an export oneself, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
